These V1 dictionaries were generated before adding norm offsets to TermInfo, at commit
227249471 (whose non-pnorm dictionary encoding is identical to main f175e1cdb).
Each contains 300 entries: key `term{i:04}`, doc_freq `i + 1`, postings range
`i*13..(i+1)*13`, and positions range `i*3..(i+1)*3`, for i in 0..300.
